verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Copilot privacy FAQ states that users can opt out of having their conversation activity used for model training at any time, and it names model training as a use of that data. This is a first-party, user-facing control that directly matches the story, though it is documented only in brief FAQ statements. Missing for 10: details on where and how the opt-out setting is exposed, clarity on whether it covers Copilot inside Office apps as well as the standalone app, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the control works.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
